clues.text: A stone mound between Jacob and Laban got this name, as Laban asked the LORD to keep watch between them.
When Jephthah came home here after defeating the Ammonites, his only daughter ran out dancing with tambourines.
Samuel gathered Israel here, where they poured out water before the LORD, fasted, and confessed their sin.
After the LORD thundered against the Philistines, Samuel set up the Ebenezer stone between this place and Shen.
Samuel called the people to the LORD here and told them they had rejected God by asking for a king.
Gedaliah, the governor Babylon set over Judah, was struck down here by Ishmael after they shared a meal.
Freed from his chains by Nebuzaradan, the prophet Jeremiah went to stay with Gedaliah in this town.
